questions.question: Define ERP systems in Logistics. Analyze the benefits of ERP.

• ERP in logistics is a software system that helps a company manage
  • and track the movement of goods from purchase to delivery in an

questions.question: Define ERP systems in Logistics. Analyze the benefits of ERP.
questions.solution_html:
• ERP in logistics is a software system that helps a company manage
  • and track the movement of goods from purchase to delivery in an
  • organized and efficient way.
  • An Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system is a
  • comprehensive software suite that integrates and manages an
  • organization’s core business processes across various
  • departments into a single, unified system. It provides a
  • centralized database and unified view of operations, improving
  • efficiency and enabling data-driven decision-making. ERP
  • systems also facilitate communication with external stakeholders
  • such as suppliers and customers.
